questions: Is the new or changed logic actually exercised by the tests in this PR, including the error and edge cases?
Were any tests weakened: assertions removed, tests skipped, or expected values changed to match new behavior without explanation?

hints.title: Test focus left in, so other tests are skipped
hints.why: With .only left in, the test runner skips every other test, so failures elsewhere go unnoticed.
hints.comment: Looks like .only was left in, which makes the runner skip the other tests. Could you remove it?

hints.title: Test turned off
hints.why: A skipped test checks nothing, and skipped tests are easy to forget.
hints.fix: Fix the test or the code it checks, or explain why it's skipped and when it comes back.
hints.comment: Why is this test skipped? Is there a plan to turn it back on?

hints.title: Checks removed from a test
hints.why: Fewer checks means the test can pass while the code is wrong.
hints.fix: Keep the removed checks, or replace them with checks for the new behavior.
hints.comment: Some checks were removed from this test. Is the old behavior still covered somewhere?
